summary: No new actionable finding in the accepted 38-stage restructuring. All 17 narrowings retain their non-imported targets; the 23 ownership boundaries and 136 proposed stage links were checked. Isolated application adds 108 edges, preserves all existing stages and consumer edges, and introduces no cycle involving a proposed edge in either checked graph. The accepted L0a-to-L4 relocation exception, upstream topology/compactness correction gate, and partial distribution decomposition remain explicit limitations, not proved inputs. This is a restructuring audit, not certification of all source proofs or of library completeness.
checked: Independence and baseline: original RS-16 producer codex-c83e7a and reviewer cc-442dc5 differ from codex-a71f92. Read RS-16 family, accepted result, report and review at 6b7b1d8e23032baa518ff5d4fe4ddfdba75959e8; target files were unchanged at publication preflight.

Read all four member roadmap documents and all 38 stage decisions (17 narrow, 21 keep), all 23 owner records and all 136 link reasons; checked original targets against retained, relocated and supplied content, including five Iwasawa readiness checkpoints.
Read all 33 reviewed library-coverage entries for the member stages. The five Iwasawa checkpoints have no audited mathematics entry. Existing partial or absent verdicts were not promoted to built.

Read the non-member endpoint descriptions for the proposed links, including the relevant completed-algebra prerequisites of ProfiniteProPGroups Layer 9, StableReduction Layer 1, S.1, P7, D7, IHG.6, analytic L-function owners, Euler-system, Selmer, patching, noncommutative, period and Birch-Tate consumers. No claim is made to have audited the unrelated Labute/bilinear-form part of ProfiniteProPGroups Layer 9.

Compared bounded measures, general adic-coefficient completed group algebras, scalar character representability, pseudomeasure evaluation and bounded O/K Amice operators against the unbounded LF/strong-dual, Mellin and coefficient-family extensions. Preserved separate additive and multiplicative convolution carriers and the dyadic chart.

Checked the L0a relocation: scalar character theory remains early; the distribution-family action moves to LAD L4. All three actual action consumers have L4 links; scalar LAD L3 does not require the relocated action. Adding L4 -> L3 would contradict the existing L3 -> L4 edge. This is the review's documented §15 exception, not an unnoticed missing prerequisite.

Read the pinned Mathlib AbstractMeasure definition, Fubini statement prodMk_eq_prodMk', Mahler statements, Measure/AmiceTransform declarations and AddChar character equivalence. The integral Z_p-linear Amice equivalence does not supply the full bounded O/K algebra/topology theory or an unbounded distribution transform; the character theorem's ultrametric and bounded-action hypotheses were retained.

Read pinned Weierstrass division/preparation and quotient/uniqueness statements, power-series Noetherian/UFD instances, and Polynomial.Monic.free_quotient. These do not supply the remaining continuity, regular-local-dimension, elementary-module, characteristic-divisor or arbitrary-order Fitting conclusions.

Checked finite-presentation Fitting ownership, generic perfect complexes versus complete-Noetherian-local derived specialization, determinant lines versus arithmetic control, and generic exterior biduals versus Euler-system contractions. The proposal does not identify finite-module characteristic ideals with Fitting ideals or drop Tor/finite-error terms.

Fresh public-source reads: Rodrigues Jacinto–Williams arXiv:2309.15692v2, Definition 3.42/Theorem 3.43 and Remark 3.44; Lemma 4.3; Lemmas 10.4–10.5 and Theorem 10.13, Definition 10.14/Theorem 10.15; Definition 11.6/Theorem 11.7; Theorem 12.23; Theorem 13.8 and Definition 13.10/Theorem 13.11 with adjacent argument. Checked bounded/unbounded topology, Coleman sign, local quotient, global unit index and conditional Vandiver boundaries. Colmez's underlying proof and Washington's index proof were not freshly audited.

Fresh public-source read: Kurihara, Class groups and Iwasawa modules, §4.1 and §4.2 including Theorem 4.1 and Lemma 4.2 with proof. Checked compact-support H2/H3, twist and inverse determinant conventions, the finite dyadic order-two cokernel, and preservation of the all-prime main-conjecture target. Not a fresh audit of the entire DKSW, Burns–Flach or Kolster proof chains.

Checked global units -> local Coleman closure -> arithmetic comparison direction, the distinction between Vandiver's cyclic module isomorphism and unconditional characteristic equality, independent Mazur–Wiles/Wiles routes, IHG.6 residual-coincidence scope, and the I.10 -> Birch-Tate B.6 specialization gate.

Read and preserved all 13 LAD L4 decomposition node statements/hypotheses, proofSteps and acceptance obligations, 19 internal links, five coverage entries and four gap records. Resolved the three PadicFamilies node consumers. The decomposition remains partial; no Fredholm product/base-change, BGR or spectral-mapping gap is declared closed.

Programmatic checks against the actual atlas and roadmap registry: exact 38-stage coverage, valid restructuring, all 136 unique endpoints, 108 newly applied edges, no skipped links, no hidden stage, all original stage ids/descriptions and all 53 outgoing member-to-nonmember edges preserved. The latter serve 43 stages in 20 roadmaps. Tau Ceti stage title/owner/description/restructured content is unchanged.

Cycle checks searched target-to-source paths for each proposed link in native-plus-proposal (3616 edges) and a conservative accepted union (7460 edges), including registry requires, 25 accepted link maps, 31 accepted research restructurings and 27 promoted restructurings. No such return path exists. This is not a claim that the entire pre-existing atlas is acyclic.

Checked reachability and direct forwarding of concrete suppliedBy stages to the original consumers. The only exception is the documented LAD L4 relocation out of PM L0a; no other concrete supplier or forwarding edge is missing in the checked union.

Preserved the existing ProfiniteProPGroups topology/compactness gate, the CC.5 noetherian p-adic-Lie input gap, Baker–Brumer independence gap and LAD partial-source gaps. These are not supplied by a name match or silently discharged.

Validation: scripts/check_redteam.py, the intake check-files path/JSON/privacy rules, in-memory check_restructure.check plus apply_restructurings and graph assertions, and git diff --check. No Lean file is requested or changed; no Lean compilation or library build was run.
